name: kuroda-autobody-patterns
description: Inventory of active reusable widgets. Restyle these after brand.ts and atoms; do not fork per page.

atoms.name: MaxWidthContainer
atoms.shape: Centred wrapper element: max-width + horizontal padding, both read from brand.layout

props.class: layout/spacing utilities only (flex, grid, gap, py-*, relative, z-*) — never max-w-* or px-*
props....attrs: id, style, data-*, aria-* are forwarded

atoms.notes: Wrap the content of EVERY section and page in this. Max width + side padding are controlled once in src/brand.ts → layout (maxWidth, paddingX, paddingXMobile). Backgrounds go on the surrounding <section>, not on the container.

atoms.name: Button
atoms.shape: Single button atom with variant + tone props

props.tone: dark (default) | light — only applies when variant=ghost

atoms.notes: primary = filled accent (terracotta), cream type. ghost tone=dark = cream outline on photos/dark. ghost tone=light = dark outline on light sections. link = inline accent text link. Font: Barlow Condensed 14px.

atoms.name: Heading
atoms.shape: All heading levels and the eyebrow label — one component
atoms.notes: Barlow Condensed for h1–h4 and eyebrow. Sizes from brand.ts type{}. color=white renders the warm off-white page color. color=default = near-black heading token.

atoms.name: Text
atoms.shape: All body and UI text — one component
atoms.notes: Work Sans for all body variants. button variant uses Barlow Condensed (display font). color=white renders the warm off-white page color.

atoms.name: BrandIcon
atoms.shape: Client PNG icon rendered 1:1 from public/icons

props.name: BrandIconName — alignment, archive, calibration, camera, chat, check, claims, clock, collision, document, home-24, paint, rental, shield, shield-24, target-24, verified, walk-around

atoms.notes: One file for all breakpoints. Never inline SVG glyphs in widgets.

patterns.name: Process steps
patterns.shape: White section: head (eyebrow + two-weight heading + lede) left; hairline-ruled ordered list right — gradient-outlined numeral, caps title, body per step.
patterns.notes: For 5+ step processes. Use ConsumerProtection for the 3-up step row.

patterns.name: Page hero
patterns.shape: Navy hero matching the homepage: photo placeholder right with the three Kuroda fade overlays, eyebrow rule, Unbounded two-tone H1, lede and the two standard CTAs. Shorter than the homepage hero, no credentials bar.

props.body?: string | string[] — array renders several lede paragraphs
props.image: {src, alt}? — CMS cover photo (blog); omit for the grey placeholder
props.showCtas: boolean — hide both buttons (contact, legal, blog)
props.slot: default slot renders under the body (e.g. article meta)

patterns.notes: Hero for every interior page. Photo stays a grey placeholder until the client supplies assets.

patterns.name: Detail rows
patterns.shape: White section: head (eyebrow + two-weight heading + lede) left; hairline-ruled label / value rows right (address, phone, hours).
patterns.notes: Use for any label/value facts list.

patterns.name: Map + directions
patterns.shape: Mist-grey section: heading, embedded map + caption left, lede + numbered direction rows + CTA right.
patterns.notes: Map is a real embed (CONTACT.address.mapsEmbedSrc), not a photo placeholder.

patterns.name: Feature columns
patterns.shape: White section: head (eyebrow + two-weight heading | lede) above a hairline-ruled grid of icon / title / description items.

props.items: { title, description, icon: BrandIconName, href? }[] — href turns the title into an arrow link
props.note? / noteLinkText? / noteLinkHref?: string — closing sentence under the grid with an inline link

patterns.notes: Unlinked icon points on a light surface. Icons come from BrandIcon.

patterns.name: Tag grid
patterns.shape: Mist-grey section: head (eyebrow + two-weight heading | lede) above a numbered 4-up grid of Unbounded Light labels with top hairlines; optional links.
patterns.notes: Short label lists: communities, areas, brands.

patterns.name: FAQ accordion
patterns.shape: White section: head (eyebrow + two-weight heading) left, hairline-ruled <details> accordion right (homepage design system)

patterns.name: Final CTA banner
patterns.shape: Page-ending conversion banner. variant=center: centred dark card with ornamental rules. variant=split: diagonal Blue → Navy surface with chevron motif, eyebrow + two-weight h2 + body + inverse/ghost buttons + address/hours row on the left, 470px team photo (grey placeholder) on the right.

props.eyebrowMobile?: string — split only, shorter eyebrow copy shown below md (Figma mobile)
props.title: string — light-weight lead
props.showBand?: boolean — render the silver band above (default true)

patterns.notes: One per page, always last section before Footer. Homepage places the silver GradientBand itself and passes showBand={false}.

patterns.name: Site header
patterns.shape: Fixed top nav with logo + links + CTA
patterns.notes: Shared chrome. Do not fork per page.

patterns.name: Ratings bar
patterns.shape: Navy band showing aggregate review scores (logo placeholder + big score + stars + platform + count) for three review platforms, separated by thin vertical dividers, with a hairline at the bottom.
patterns.notes: Data is hardcoded from Figma (CARWISE 4.9, Google 4.6, Yelp 4.5). Logo placeholders must stay grey boxes until client delivers brand assets.

patterns.name: Credential logos
patterns.shape: White section: head row (eyebrow, two-weight heading, lede | underline text link) above a 6-up row of credential tiles (110px logo slot, Unbounded name, caption) with hairline dividers; 2-column grid on mobile with the text link moved below the grid.

props.credentials?: { name, descriptor, logoW, logoH }[] — logo is a grey placeholder at logoW × logoH
props.linkText?: string — pass "" to hide the link

patterns.notes: Logos are grey boxes until the client supplies assets. Uses the new Button variant=underline (Figma Text Link).

patterns.name: Content page (data-driven)
patterns.shape: Whole interior page from one data object: PageHero → blue band → sections[] (features | table | steps | story | quote) → FAQs (optional) → related TagGrid → CTABanner (own silver band). Surfaces alternate page/subtle automatically.

props.page: ContentPage — see src/data/contentPage.ts; copy in src/data/collisionRepair.ts, hadAnAccident.ts and ourStory.ts (/about/)

patterns.notes: Use for every copy-driven page (Collision Repair services, Had an Accident topics, future groups). New page = add an object to the group's data file + a 3-line route file calling getContentPage(path). Never add per-page markup. Hero buttons and the closing-CTA subtitle/buttons are shared defaults of PageHero / CTABanner (src/config/cta.ts). `**bold**` in leads and feature descriptions renders as <strong>.

patterns.name: Quote band
patterns.shape: Section with an optional eyebrow and a single PullQuote (gradient vertical rule, Unbounded quote, eyebrow-style attribution).

patterns.name: Heritage story
patterns.shape: Mist-grey section: archive photo (grey placeholder, 470×560) with icon caption on the left; eyebrow, two-tone heading with gradient accent, lede, pull quote with vertical gradient rule, and a 3-up stats row with dividers on the right.

props.isReversed?: boolean — photo on the right from xl up (alternate on long story pages)

patterns.notes: Defaults hold the Kuroda copy from Figma. Pass quote="", stats={[]}, caption="" or eyebrow="" to drop those blocks (e.g. Post-Repair Walkthrough). Photo stays a grey box until client supplies assets.

patterns.name: Before & after
patterns.shape: White section: eyebrow + two-tone heading with side paragraph; full-width before/after comparison (grey placeholder, centre divider, round handle, Before/After tags); three proof points (icon + Unbounded title + line) with hairlines on top.
patterns.notes: Static comparison for now. Make the divider draggable once real before/after photos exist. Comparison stays a grey box until then.

patterns.name: Feature list split
patterns.shape: Mist-grey section: eyebrow + full-width two-tone heading; below, a photo (grey placeholder) with caption on the left and four numbered icon/title/description rows (hairline on top, index number at right) on the right, rows matching the photo height.
patterns.notes: Defaults hold the Kuroda copy from Figma. Photo stays a grey box (bg-placeholder-on-grey) until client supplies assets.

patterns.name: Service grid split
patterns.shape: Tall photo (grey placeholder, bleeds to container edge) with caption on the left; eyebrow, two-tone heading and a 2-column grid of icon + title + description items (hairline on top) on the right.
patterns.notes: Defaults hold the Kuroda copy from Figma. Photo must stay a grey box until the client supplies assets.

patterns.name: Site footer
patterns.shape: Footer band with logo, link columns, legal links, copyright
patterns.notes: Shared chrome. Do not fork per page.

patterns.name: Phase / comparison table
patterns.shape: Eyebrow + heading + optional lead above a real <table> on md+ that collapses to stacked label/value rows on mobile

props.rows: string[][] — first cell is the row header

patterns.notes: Use for any label → multi-column facts. Do not hand-roll tables in pages.

patterns.name: Blog grid
patterns.shape: Optional head (eyebrow + two-weight heading | lede) above a hairline-ruled grid of BlogCards; first post can render as a wide featured card; empty state when there are no posts

props.featured: boolean — first post as wide card

patterns.notes: The only place articles are listed (blog index, 'More articles' on a post). Cards are BlogCard — never hand-roll article markup.
